question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sporadic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Regular.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sporadic"** means something occurring at irregular intervals or happening only occasionally; it is not constant or regular. (छिटपुट)
 
 
• **Example:** His attendance in class was sporadic, so he missed many important lessons.
 

 
• **"Regular"** refers to something happening at consistent intervals or occurring frequently. It is the opposite of sporadic. (नियमित)
 
 
• **Example:** She goes for a regular morning walk every day without fail.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Sporadic'** is **'Regular'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Regular.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **National** (राष्ट्रीय): Relating to a nation or country as a whole.
 
 
• **Example:** Independence Day is a national holiday in many countries.
 
 

 
• **Aromatic** (सुगंधित): Having a pleasant and distinctive smell.
 
 
• **Example:** The aromatic spices filled the kitchen with a delightful fragrance.
 
 

 
• **Scant** (अल्प): Barely sufficient or adequate in quantity.
 
 
• **Example:** The resources available for the project were scant, making it difficult to complete on time.
